Hi coaches, Luigi Bettino is the national coach working for the Italian Tennis Federation, a PTR international master professional and educational director of the PTR in Italy. Since 1992, he has been coaching and working as the tennis director at a number of famous facilities such as Le Pliati Centre in Turin, Monviso, Stamper Sporting in Turin and finally Piati Tennis Centre in Borgheta. Luigi's main focus is the management of junior tennis development programs and research into teaching methods. He has written many articles for Tennis Italia magazine, an author of the book Munchkin Tennis, 360 Serve DVD and a speaker at many international tennis conferences. Please welcome Luigi as he shares with us the secrets of the Italian system. Hey, thanks Scott. Good afternoon and welcome everybody. Before starting this presentation about the success of the Italian system, I would like to share with you all some of the reasons in my opinion why tennis is reborn in Italy in this last five or six years. And we will try also to analyze together what were the problems and that we had in Italy
